[[File:RedPearl.jpg|thumb|right|upright|The red pearl helped grow food pearls for the underwater dwellers.]]
The '''red pearl''' was a [[Pearl/Legends|pearl]] owned by an [[Unidentified finned amphibious species/Legends|Unidentified amphibious sentient species]] in a grotto deep under the surface of [[Sunshine Lake]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. The red pearl helped grow [[food pearl]]s, the main food source of the [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="E9 ">[[Ewoks (1985) 9|''Ewoks'' 9]]</ref> After the red pearl was destroyed in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] during a confrontation with the tyrant [[Orcon/Legends|Orcon]], it was replaced by a [[blue pearl]] that was even more powerful.<ref name="E9 " />
